notes.title: [2024-05-24] Game Update
notes.content:
New patch went live. Here are the changes:
- 16 new buildings, most of them simply convert one resource to another with the help of moderators, eventually increasing your faction's income.
- Technology Tree which upgrades those buildings, improving their efficiency, number of moderators and so on.
- One new tutorial quest introducing the player to the Technology Tree.
- Four new regular quests that reward the player with Netcoins and Faction EXP. These are given by the following buildings:
-> Botmaster Hub
-> Hosting Hub
-> Denial Center
-> Combo Checker
The buildings convert Proxy/Hash/Combo resources into other stuff but having those resources isn't required for them to give the player quests.
After a quest is spawned, an exclamation will appear above it until the player takes the quest or it expires.
- There are now three tiers of malware entities: normal, advanced and supreme, each with better stats.
- They can be recruited by the player and also spawn during a raid.
- Keeping malware entities now costs the player upkeep; depending on the tier, from 2 Netcoins to 6 Netcoins every 15 seconds.
- In a similar fashion, recruiting moderators now costs 1 Netcoins / 15s in upkeep.
- There are now three tiers of towers, each with better stats.
- Similarly, there also three tiers of defensive Walls, which can be used to wall off player's base for more protection.
- There are new Farming buildings; the player can place a Proxy Farm which will transform 5x5 surrounding area into Proxy Resources, same goes for other resources.

notes.title: [2024-04-07] Game Update
notes.content:
New update went live, adding early versions of a moderator mechanic and a system to transfer resources between buildings. The player will need to place a Chatroom which yields Population and then direct the population to an Entry Point where the player can assign a moderator that will "verify" the population by completing the applicants minigame and yield some Money and Verified Accounts (which have no use yet). The same goes for the buildings that gather proxies/combolists etc., these will need to route their output to a Trade Point.

The applicant minigame was reworked because it was a bit mundane/boring. Instead the minigame now focuses on applying different categories to given applicant based on the dialogue. You can do the minigame either yourself or assign a moderator to it.

The new mechanics are in alpha version and there's still lots to do, e.g. for now you don't need to pay your moderators and there aren't many buildings yet. There is also no tutorial yet so the game might be confusing.

notes.title: [2024-02-01] Game patchnotes
notes.content:
New Threat Actor update just went live. Here are the highlights:
- A completely new 3D map.

- Ability to place buildings on the 3D map.

- Ability to create and move around your faction's malware entities around the map.

- The "Boss" sequence was completely removed and now you're the boss of your own marketplace.

- The Boss was replaced with a short tutorial dialogue at the start.

- Every 5 minutes, there's a raid of hostile entities on your base that you have to defend from (this will be expanded to hostile faction later on)

- Since there are no sleeping sequences anymore, the applicants minigame was adjusted to switch rules every x minutes, also only pick three random rules at a time.

- The applicants minigame now gives you money that you can use to purchase buildings on the 3d map.

- You are able to command your entities. Currently there are 4 command options: "MoveTo" which makes the entity go to a location. "Guard" which makes it wander around a point. "Wander" to just wander around and "Stand" to do nothing and stand in one place.

- The 3d map features a "Fog of War", so you're only able to see things that are close to friendly buildings/entities. The Fog of War is marked with the "stars" vfx.

notes.title: [2023-11-05] Patchnotes for THREAT ACTOR: DEMO
notes.content:
New patch for the demo went live. Changes:
[list]
[*] The player can now click the market / player base with the mouse to set it in focus for connection.
[*] The dark web UI was revamped, the three big buttons were changed to a list of known hosts in the upper left corner.
[*] Web Crawler entities now take other entities into consideration when pathfinding, so they no longer clip into each other.
[*] Entities received a medium performance boost.
[*] Dark Web now looks a bit different: player's camera no longer has a light and instead the market / base have their own illumination.
[/list]

notes.title: [2023-11-03] New patchnotes for THREAT ACTOR: DEMO
notes.content:
New patch for the demo went live. Changes:
[list]
[*] Added little "web crawlers" on the 3d map. They don't do anything yet, just wander around and sometimes clip into each other cause I haven't done entity collision yet; in the future they'll be able to attack servers.
[*] Removed the "Disconnect" button from market ui that I forgot earlier. It teleported the player to the base server instead of navigating through the dark web.
[*] Fixed a small bug where after selecting market/base on 3d map the camera's movement was disabled until player scrolled.
[/list]

notes.title: [2023-11-02] Patchnotes for THREAT ACTOR: DEMO
notes.content:
New quick update went live. Changes:
[list]
[*] The dark web map now unloads during the sleeping sequence. This should add a minor performance boost and also prevent dark web particles from clipping through the rooms.
[*] Fixed a bug that made camera be able to travel infinitely or disable movement at weird locations. The camera is now stopped before it goes beyond the spawned world.
[*] Most messages have a "thinking delay" before they're written to make it seem more realistic. Some messages, like player responses or system responses, are not supposed to have it. Fixed a bug where the "Your applicaton was rejected" and "User was banned" messages were displayed with a delay.
[*] The dark web particles are now a bit slower.
[/list]

notes.title: [2023-11-01] Patchnotes for THREAT ACTOR: DEMO
notes.content:
New small demo update went live. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*] Removed the environment that was shown by the three cameras after going to sleep. Added three smaller environments which are shown instead. This results in a big performance boost during the sleeping sequence.
[*] Made the stats shown after sleeping look a bit better, in grayscale colors fitting the camera desaturation.
[*] To avoid new player confusion, the player is no longer allowed to go into the dark web before adding the market's ip sent by Boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Submit your username and have it appear in game!
notes.content:
Hello all the dark web enthusiasts,

recently we've added a #threat-actor-bot channel on our Discord [[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]invite[/url]], where people can submit their username and [b]have a chance for it to appear in THREAT ACTOR.[/b]

All submitted usernames will be added to an ingame nickname pool automatically. Just like every hitman in XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX generates with a custom username, so will the various cybercriminals in THREAT ACTOR, expect their username choice will be [b]drawn from the nickname pool submitted by our Discord members.[/b]

You don't need a rank or anything to submit your username. Just join our Discord, head over to the #threat-actor-bot channel and type the /add_username command. Additionally, you can also use the /generate_npc command to draw a random username from the pool along with some random traits.

The Discord invite can be found here:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU[/url]

notes.title: The development of THREAT ACTOR just started!
notes.content:
Hello,

after the sucessful launch of XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX, we've now moved to our next game, THREAT ACTOR. The success of cyberrat has taught us a lot of lessons: not only from a technical perspective, but it also gave us more of a defined idea [b]what players want and enjoy in dark, cybercrime-themed games.[/b]

Compared to cyberrat, THREAT ACTOR will have a bigger budget and more realistic, detailed and polished mechanics. Instead of relying on roguelike resets after death and time-based pressure, THREAT ACTOR will be a game focused on [b]dark web exploration and interactions with other cybercriminals[/b].

Instead of roguelike permament death, the player will be punished for his/her failures in a more balanced way: the [b]death of your party members[/b] that you've spent a lot of time leveling up, your [b]precious marketplaces overtaken by hostile factions[/b], and your own character getting [b]more and more deluded and paranoid[/b]. Depending on your gameplay style, [b]your character will experience anxiety attacks and hallucinations[/b], adding horror elements on top of regular gameplay.

I will also try to add as many level-up / traits / skills mechanics as I can, to really [b]give the player the sense of his cybercrime faction getting stronger and stronger[/b], slowly dominating the Dark Web and overcoming other cybercrime factions.

For now, the game is in very early development: there are only a couple of UIs I've designed and a general concept. As the game is being developed, more content will be added to the store page, first of which is probably the main 2.5D map representing the Dark Web.

If you want to follow the development of the game and make some suggestions, make sure to [b]join our Discord[/b]:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU]https://discord.com/invite/tqGc7xKtsU[/url]
